incidents.cause: Failure of the engine cylinder assembly, which resulted in a loss of engine power during cruise flight and an impact with a fence during the forced landing.
The pilot's intentional low-level flight and failure to maintain a visual lookout.

Failure of the pilot to maintain control of the airplane during the landing.
